assets.prompt: Two adult travelers meeting under a flowering plum tree by a moonlit Korean garden pond, gentle mutual curiosity.

Two warm lantern reflections meeting on a quiet lotus pond, a symbolic familiar connection.
Two young flowering trees growing on opposite banks joined by a graceful stone bridge, a symbolic growing connection.
A loosely woven silk ribbon resting beside a lotus flower and a softly lit window, a symbolic knot that can be patiently untied.
